name: Creative Sound Blaster Intelligent Organ (ORGAN.EXE)
description: Faithful clone of Creative Labs' legacy ORGAN.EXE v2.02 (1988-1990) for 386DX-40 MS-DOS systems, featuring dual Philips SAA1099 sound generator chips (C/MS · Game Blaster 12 stereo voices), stripped rhythm/metronome background noise, Gameport MIDI input, and 16-bit DOS binary export.
